_comment: Flags in notes.tsv are 'category: detail'. revise = the seller must check before sealing (goes in the revise list and the needs-check count). note = shown on the row only.

revise.item: Item unclear (audio and camera disagree, or pictures do not show it)
revise.missing: No video or audio at the sale
revise.ghost: Sold on stream but no order in Whatnot

note.bag: Bag or basket contents from the audio
note.expiry: Expiration date read off the box
note.timing: Matched by time, number not heard
